description: Consolidated worklist of the worst IB rails in the fleet: down links, flap history, congestion and transport errors. Source: ib_hca_* counters read from every DGX tray's channel adapters (job=node / node-exporter, four rails per tray). IB byte counters are reported in 32-bit words and are multiplied by 4 to give bytes.

options.content:
Host-HCA InfiniBand boards  |  Rail State & Cabling  ·  Blast Radius  ·  Link Flaps  ·  Port Errors  ·  Congestion & Throughput  ·  Signal Quality  ·  Worst Offenders
Source: ib_hca_* counters read on every DGX tray by node-exporter, four rails per tray. Every number on the left of a band is backed by the table beside it, built from the identical selector — the table footer prints the row count.

panels.title: Every rail carrying a host-side fault — the triage worklist

panels.description: Distinct HCA rails tripping at least one host-side fault indicator. Fault set = port state not ACTIVE, link-down history, receive / packet-sequence / out-of-sequence / duplicate-request / ACK-timeout / completion-queue errors, symbol errors and link-error recovery. Congestion counters (transmit-wait, RNR NAK, out-of-buffer) are deliberately excluded — they are performance, not faults, and live on the Congestion & Throughput board. The table beside this number is built from the identical selector, so its row count equals the number shown.

targets.expr: count by(node,rack,su)(ib_hca_port_state{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} != 4 or ib_hca_link_downed{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_out_of_sequence{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_duplicate_request{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_req_cqe_error{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_resp_cqe_error{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_symbol_error{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_link_error_recovery{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0)

panels.title: Trays with a faulted rail — the exact trays

panels.description: Distinct rails reporting packet-sequence errors, receive errors or local ACK timeouts — the transport-layer subset of the fault set. Per-counter breakdowns live on the Port Errors board. The table beside this number is built from the identical selector, so its row count equals the number shown.

targets.expr: count(count by(instance,hca)(ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rails with transport errors

panels.description: One row per rail reporting a transport-layer error, with the three counters behind it. Built from the identical selector as the number on the left, so the row count equals it.

targets.expr: max by(node,rack,su,hca)(ib_hca_port_state{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} and on(node,hca) (ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0))

max by(node,rack,su,hca)(ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} and on(node,hca) (ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0))

max by(node,rack,su,hca)(ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} and on(node,hca) (ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0))

max by(node,rack,su,hca)(ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} and on(node,hca) (ib_hca_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_port_rcv_errors{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0 or ib_hca_local_ack_timeout_err{cluster=~"$cluster",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack",node=~"$node",hca=~"$hca"} > 0))
